meta.description: The Internal Committee at XLRI Delhi-NCR prevents, supports and resolves concerns about sexual harassment — how to reach it, how a complaint is handled, its members and the policy documents.

title: Internal Complaints Committee
headline: A safe, respectful and accountable campus for everyone
standfirst: The Internal Committee exists to prevent, support and resolve concerns about sexual harassment — fairly, confidentially, and without delay.
intro: At XLRI Delhi-NCR, we are committed to fostering an academic and work environment built on dignity, respect, equality, safety and inclusion. The Internal Committee is constituted to prevent, prohibit and address sexual harassment, and to provide an accessible, fair and confidential mechanism for addressing complaints.

harassment.eyebrow: Know it when you see it
harassment.title: What is sexual harassment?
harassment.note: It may include, but is not limited to, the following.
items: Requests or demands for sexual favours
Unwelcome flirtations, propositions, suggestive remarks or taunts
Sexually explicit jokes, gestures, sounds or communications
Displaying pornography or sexually explicit material
Unwelcome visual, verbal or physical conduct of a sexual nature

process.title: The inquiry process, at a glance
process.text: A visual guide to the complaint process — from reporting an incident to inquiry and resolution.
process.start: Incidence of workplace sexual harassment to be reported within 3 months

informal.label: Informal
outcomes: The respondent fulfils his obligations as agreed upon: the case is closed
The respondent fails to fulfil his obligations as agreed upon: an inquiry will commence

formal.label: Formal
steps: One copy of the complaint to be submitted to the respondent, to which the respondent needs to reply within 10 days
Inquiry report to be completed within 90 days by the ICC/LCC
Report of the findings to be submitted to the employer or district officer (DO) and concerned parties within 10 days of completion of the inquiry

outcomes.label: Complaint upheld
outcomes.text: Recommendations to be implemented by the employer/DO within 60 days on receipt of the report

outcomes.label: Complaint not upheld: inconclusive
outcomes.text: Recommend to employer/DO that no action is required to be taken

formal.appeal: If not satisfied by the recommendations or non-implementation of such recommendations, the complainant and the respondent can appeal to a tribunal/court within 90 days

items.title: Students
items.text: May approach the IC for guidance, support, or to report concerns related to sexual harassment.

items.title: Faculty & staff
items.text: May approach the IC for guidance, support, or to report concerns related to sexual harassment or inappropriate conduct.

items.title: Other members
items.text: Other members of the XLRI community may seek assistance regarding concerns related to sexual harassment.

steps.title: Submit your complaint
steps.text: In writing to the IC, with relevant details of the incident and persons involved.

steps.title: IC reviews the complaint
steps.text: The IC takes necessary steps in accordance with the applicable policy and procedure.

steps.title: Resolution & support
steps.text: A fair, confidential and documented process, with support for the complainant.

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.text: Powers, rights, timelines and applicability — all in one place.

items.question: When should a complaint be filed?
answer: Ordinarily within three months of the incident, or the last incident in a series. Where more time is needed, the IC can consider the circumstances and decide accordingly.

items.question: What happens after a complaint is filed?
answer: The IC acknowledges the complaint, reviews the matter, and conducts the inquiry fairly and confidentially where applicable. Appropriate action follows based on the findings, with support provided throughout.

items.question: Powers of the IC
list: Summoning and requiring attendance of relevant persons
Examining persons as part of the inquiry
Requiring discovery and production of documents
Seeking information or material necessary for the inquiry

items.question: Your rights during the process
list: Interim measures where appropriate, to support safety and wellbeing

items.question: Where does the policy apply?
answer: Institute premises, Institute-related activities, and other spaces where XLRI community members interact in connection with the Institute — classrooms, offices, hostels, libraries, transportation, field visits, internships, seminars, social and sporting events, and online/digital spaces.

items.question: If you need immediate assistance
answer: If you feel unsafe or need immediate assistance, contact appropriate campus authorities or emergency services, as applicable.

contact.title: Need to talk to someone?
contact.text: Write to the IC, or approach any listed member. If you need help putting a complaint in writing, the IC will assist.
